spec.name: shaft_bracket_torsion
spec.description: 160 x 80 x 80 mm steel shaft bracket, x=0 end bolted rigidly to gearbox; 40 N*m torque about +x applied at x=160 via two 16x16 mm drive lugs (top and bottom, centred z=40) as an equal and opposite z-force couple. supports.note: x=0 end bolted rigidly to gearbox
